fields.name: Protocol Version
fields.notes: See protocol version numbers (currently 767 in Minecraft 1.21).

fields.name: Server Address
fields.notes: Hostname or IP, e.g. localhost or 127.0.0.1, that was used to connect. The Notchian server does not use this information. Note that SRV records are a simple redirect, e.g. if _minecraft._tcp.example.com points to mc.example.org, users connecting to example.com will provide example.org as server address in addition to connecting to it.

fields.name: Server Port
fields.notes: Default is 25565. The Notchian server does not use this information.

fields.name: Next State
fields.notes: 1 for Status, 2 for Login, 3 for Transfer.

fields.name: Payload
fields.notes: always 1 (0x01).

fields.name: JSON Response
fields.notes: See Server List Ping#Status Response; as with all strings this is prefixed by its length as a VarInt.

fields.name: Timestamp
fields.notes: Should match the one sent by the client.

fields.name: Timestamp
fields.notes: May be any number, but Notchian clients use will always use the timestamp in milliseconds.

fields.name: Reason
fields.notes: The reason why the player was disconnected.

fields.name: Server ID
fields.notes: Appears to be empty.

fields.name: Public Key Length
fields.notes: Length of Public Key.

fields.name: Public Key
fields.notes: The server's public key, in bytes.

fields.name: Verify Token Length
fields.notes: Length of Verify Token. Always 4 for Notchian servers.

fields.name: Verify Token
fields.notes: A sequence of random bytes generated by the server.

fields.name: Should authenticate
fields.notes: Whether the client should attempt to authenticate through mojang servers.

fields.name: Number Of Properties
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array.

fields.name: Strict Error Handling
fields.notes: Whether the client should immediately disconnect upon a packet processing error. The Notchian client silently ignores them when this flag is false. This field was temporarily added in 1.20.5 as a way to aid modded servers with the transition to the new data pack & registry system, allowing them to tell the client to silently ignore packets containing inconsistent data. It will be removed in 1.21.2, but it is still present as of version 1.21.1.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.notes: Maximum size of a packet before it is compressed.

fields.name: Message ID
fields.notes: Generated by the server - should be unique to the connection.

fields.name: Channel
fields.notes: Name of the plugin channel used to send the data.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Any data, depending on the channel. The length of this array must be inferred from the packet length.

fields.name: Key
fields.notes: The identifier of the cookie.

fields.name: Name
fields.notes: Player's Username.

fields.name: Player UUID
fields.notes: The UUID of the player logging in. Unused by the Notchian server.

fields.name: Shared Secret Length
fields.notes: Length of Shared Secret.

fields.name: Shared Secret
fields.notes: Shared Secret value, encrypted with the server's public key.

fields.name: Verify Token Length
fields.notes: Length of Verify Token.

fields.name: Verify Token
fields.notes: Verify Token value, encrypted with the same public key as the shared secret.

fields.name: Message ID
fields.notes: Should match ID from server.

fields.name: Successful
fields.notes: true if the client understood the request, false otherwise. When false, no payload follows.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Any data, depending on the channel. The length of this array must be inferred from the packet length.

fields.name: Key
fields.notes: The identifier of the cookie.

fields.name: Has Payload
fields.notes: The payload is only present if the cookie exists on the client.

fields.name: Payload Length
fields.notes: Length of the following byte array.

fields.name: Payload
fields.notes: The data of the cookie, if any.

fields.name: Key
fields.notes: The identifier of the cookie.

fields.name: Channel
fields.notes: Name of the plugin channel used to send the data.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Any data. The length of this array must be inferred from the packet length.

fields.name: Reason
fields.notes: The reason why the player was disconnected.

fields.name: Entry Count
fields.notes: Number of entries in the following array.

fields.name: Has UUID
fields.notes: Whether a specific resource pack should be removed, or all of them.

fields.name: UUID
fields.notes: The UUID of the resource pack to be removed. Only present if the previous field is true.

fields.name: UUID
fields.notes: The unique identifier of the resource pack.

fields.name: URL
fields.notes: The URL to the resource pack.

fields.name: Hash
fields.notes: A 40 character hexadecimal, case-insensitive SHA-1 hash of the resource pack file. If it's not a 40 character hexadecimal string, the client will not use it for hash verification and likely waste bandwidth.

fields.name: Forced
fields.notes: The Notchian client will be forced to use the resource pack from the server. If they decline they will be kicked from the server.

fields.name: Has Prompt Message
fields.notes: Whether a custom message should be used on the resource pack prompt.

fields.name: Prompt Message
fields.notes: This is shown in the prompt making the client accept or decline the resource pack. Only present if the previous field is true.

fields.name: Key
fields.notes: The identifier of the cookie.

fields.name: Payload Length
fields.notes: Length of the following byte array.

fields.name: Payload
fields.notes: The data of the cookie.

fields.name: Host
fields.notes: The hostname or IP of the server.

fields.name: Port
fields.notes: The port of the server.

fields.name: Total Features
fields.notes: Number of features that appear in the array below.

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: Registry identifier (Vanilla expects tags for the registries minecraft:block, minecraft:item, minecraft:fluid, minecraft:entity_type, and minecraft:game_event)

fields.name: Known Pack Count
fields.notes: The number of known packs in the following array.

fields.name: Details Count
fields.notes: The number of details in the following array.

fields.name: Links Count
fields.notes: The number of links in the following array.

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: True if Label is an enum (built-in label), false if it's a text component (custom label).

fields.name: Locale
fields.notes: e.g. en_GB.

fields.name: View Distance
fields.notes: Client-side render distance, in chunks.

fields.name: Chat Mode
fields.notes: 0: enabled, 1: commands only, 2: hidden. See Chat#Client chat mode for more information.

fields.name: Chat Colors
fields.notes: “Colors” multiplayer setting. The Notchian server stores this value but does nothing with it (see MC-64867). Third-party servers such as Hypixel disable all coloring in chat and system messages when it is false.

fields.name: Displayed Skin Parts
fields.notes: Bit mask, see below.

fields.name: Main Hand
fields.notes: 0: Left, 1: Right.

fields.name: Enable text filtering
fields.notes: Enables filtering of text on signs and written book titles. The Notchian client sets this according to the profanityFilterPreferences.profanityFilterOn account attribute indicated by the /player/attributes Mojang API endpoint. In offline mode it is always false.

fields.name: Allow server listings
fields.notes: Servers usually list online players, this option should let you not show up in that list.

fields.name: Key
fields.notes: The identifier of the cookie.

fields.name: Has Payload
fields.notes: The payload is only present if the cookie exists on the client.

fields.name: Payload Length
fields.notes: Length of the following byte array.

fields.name: Payload
fields.notes: The data of the cookie, if any.

fields.name: Channel
fields.notes: Name of the plugin channel used to send the data.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Any data, depending on the channel. minecraft: channels are documented here. The length of this array must be inferred from the packet length.

fields.name: ID
fields.notes: id is the same as the ping packet

fields.name: UUID
fields.notes: The unique identifier of the resource pack received in the Add Resource Pack (configuration) request.

fields.name: Result
fields.notes: Result ID (see below).

fields.name: Known Pack Count
fields.notes: The number of known packs in the following array.

fields.name: Entity ID
fields.notes: A unique integer ID mostly used in the protocol to identify the entity.

fields.name: Entity UUID
fields.notes: A unique identifier that is mostly used in persistence and places where the uniqueness matters more.

fields.name: Type
fields.notes: ID in the minecraft:entity_type registry (see "type" field in Entity metadata#Entities).

fields.name: Pitch
fields.notes: To get the real pitch, you must divide this by (256.0F / 360.0F)

fields.name: Yaw
fields.notes: To get the real yaw, you must divide this by (256.0F / 360.0F)

fields.name: Head Yaw
fields.notes: Only used by living entities, where the head of the entity may differ from the general body rotation.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Meaning dependent on the value of the Type field, see Object Data for details.

fields.name: Velocity X
fields.notes: Same units as Set Entity Velocity.

fields.name: Velocity Y
fields.notes: Same units as Set Entity Velocity.

fields.name: Velocity Z
fields.notes: Same units as Set Entity Velocity.

fields.name: Count
fields.notes: The amount of experience this orb will reward once collected.

fields.name: Entity ID
fields.notes: Player ID.

fields.name: Animation
fields.notes: Animation ID (see below).

fields.name: Count
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array.

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: See below.

fields.name: Sequence ID
fields.notes: Represents the sequence to acknowledge, this is used for properly syncing block changes to the client after interactions.

fields.name: Entity ID
fields.notes: The ID of the entity breaking the block.

fields.name: Location
fields.notes: Block Position.

fields.name: Destroy Stage
fields.notes: 0–9 to set it, any other value to remove it.

fields.name: Type
fields.notes: The type of the block entity

fields.name: NBT Data
fields.notes: Data to set. May be a TAG_END (0), in which case the block entity at the given location is removed (though this is not required since the client will remove the block entity automatically on chunk unload or block removal).

fields.name: Location
fields.notes: Block coordinates.

fields.name: Action ID (Byte 1)
fields.notes: Varies depending on block — see Block Actions.

fields.name: Action Parameter (Byte 2)
fields.notes: Varies depending on block — see Block Actions.

fields.name: Block Type
fields.notes: The block type ID for the block. This value is unused by the Notchian client, as it will infer the type of block based on the given position.

fields.name: Location
fields.notes: Block Coordinates.

fields.name: Block ID
fields.notes: The new block state ID for the block as given in the block state registry.

fields.name: UUID
fields.notes: Unique ID for this bar.

fields.name: Action
fields.notes: Determines the layout of the remaining packet.

fields.name: Health
fields.notes: From 0 to 1. Values greater than 1 do not crash a Notchian client, and start rendering part of a second health bar at around 1.5.

fields.name: Color
fields.notes: Color ID (see below).

fields.name: Division
fields.notes: Type of division (see below).

fields.name: Flags
fields.notes: Bit mask. 0x01: should darken sky, 0x02: is dragon bar (used to play end music), 0x04: create fog (previously was also controlled by 0x02).

fields.name: Health
fields.notes: as above

fields.name: Color
fields.notes: Color ID (see below).

fields.name: Dividers
fields.notes: as above

fields.name: Flags
fields.notes: as above

fields.name: Difficulty
fields.notes: 0: peaceful, 1: easy, 2: normal, 3: hard.

fields.name: Batch size
fields.notes: Number of chunks.

fields.name: Number of chunks
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: Chunk coordinate (block coordinate divided by 16, rounded down)

fields.name: ID
fields.notes: Transaction ID.

fields.name: Start
fields.notes: Start of the text to replace.

fields.name: Length
fields.notes: Length of the text to replace.

fields.name: Count
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array.

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: One eligible value to insert, note that each command is sent separately instead of in a single string, hence the need for Count. Note that for instance this doesn't include a leading / on commands.

fields.name: Count
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array.

fields.name: Nodes
fields.notes: An array of nodes.

fields.name: Root index
fields.notes: Index of the root node in the previous array.

fields.name: Window ID
fields.notes: This is the ID of the window that was closed. 0 for inventory.

fields.name: Window ID
fields.notes: The ID of window which items are being sent for. 0 for player inventory. The client ignores any packets targeting a Window ID other than the current one. However, an exception is made for the player inventory, which may be targeted at any time. (The Notchian server does not appear to utilize this special case.)

fields.name: State ID
fields.notes: A server-managed sequence number used to avoid desynchronization; see Click Container.

fields.name: Count
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array.

fields.name: Carried Item
fields.notes: Item being dragged with the mouse.

fields.name: Property
fields.notes: The property to be updated, see below.

fields.name: Value
fields.notes: The new value for the property, see below.

fields.name: Window ID
fields.notes: The window which is being updated. 0 for player inventory. The client ignores any packets targeting a Window ID other than the current one; see below for exceptions.

fields.name: State ID
fields.notes: A server-managed sequence number used to avoid desynchronization; see Click Container.

fields.name: Slot
fields.notes: The slot that should be updated.

fields.name: Key
fields.notes: The identifier of the cookie.

fields.name: Item ID
fields.notes: Numeric ID of the item to apply a cooldown to.

fields.name: Cooldown Ticks
fields.notes: Number of ticks to apply a cooldown for, or 0 to clear the cooldown.

fields.name: Action
fields.notes: 0: Add, 1: Remove, 2: Set

fields.name: Count
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array.

fields.name: Channel
fields.notes: Name of the plugin channel used to send the data.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Any data. The length of this array must be inferred from the packet length.

fields.name: Entity ID
fields.notes: The ID of the entity taking damage

fields.name: Source Type ID
fields.notes: The type of damage in the minecraft:damage_type registry, defined by the Registry Data packet.

fields.name: Source Cause ID
fields.notes: The ID + 1 of the entity responsible for the damage, if present. If not present, the value is 0

fields.name: Source Direct ID
fields.notes: The ID + 1 of the entity that directly dealt the damage, if present. If not present, the value is 0. If this field is present: * and damage was dealt indirectly, such as by the use of a projectile, this field will contain the ID of such projectile; * and damage was dealt dirctly, such as by manually attacking, this field will contain the same value as Source Cause ID.

fields.name: Has Source Position
fields.notes: Indicates the presence of the three following fields. The Notchian server sends the Source Position when the damage was dealt by the /damage command and a position was specified

fields.name: Source Position X
fields.notes: Only present if Has Source Position is true

fields.name: Source Position Y
fields.notes: Only present if Has Source Position is true

fields.name: Source Position Z
fields.notes: Only present if Has Source Position is true

fields.name: Sample Length
fields.notes: The length of the following array.

fields.name: Sample
fields.notes: Array of type-dependent samples.

fields.name: Sample Type
fields.notes: See below.

fields.name: Message ID
fields.notes: The message Id + 1, used for validating message signature. The next field is present only when value of this field is equal to 0.

fields.name: Signature
fields.notes: The previous message's signature. Always 256 bytes and not length-prefixed.

fields.name: Reason
fields.notes: Displayed to the client when the connection terminates.

fields.name: Message
fields.notes: This is used as the content parameter when formatting the message on the client.

fields.name: Chat Type
fields.notes: The type of chat in the minecraft:chat_type registry, defined by the Registry Data packet.

fields.name: Sender Name
fields.notes: The name of the one sending the message, usually the sender's display name. This is used as the sender parameter when formatting the message on the client.

fields.name: Has Target Name
fields.notes: True if target name is present.

fields.name: Target Name
fields.notes: The name of the one receiving the message, usually the receiver's display name. Only present if previous boolean is true. This is used as the target parameter when formatting the message on the client.

fields.name: Entity Status
fields.notes: See Entity statuses for a list of which statuses are valid for each type of entity.

fields.name: Strength
fields.notes: If the strength is greater or equal to 2.0, or the block interaction is not 0 (keep), large explosion particles are used. Otherwise, small explosion particles are used.

fields.name: Record Count
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array.

fields.name: Records
fields.notes: Each record is 3 signed bytes long; the 3 bytes are the XYZ (respectively) signed offsets of affected blocks.

fields.name: Player Motion X
fields.notes: X velocity of the player being pushed by the explosion.

fields.name: Player Motion Y
fields.notes: Y velocity of the player being pushed by the explosion.

fields.name: Player Motion Z
fields.notes: Z velocity of the player being pushed by the explosion.

fields.name: Block Interaction
fields.notes: 0 = keep, 1 = destroy, 2 = destroy_with_decay, 3 = trigger_block.

fields.name: Small Explosion Particle ID
fields.notes: The particle ID listed in Particles.

fields.name: Small Explosion Particle Data
fields.notes: Particle data as specified in Particles.

fields.name: Large Explosion Particle ID
fields.notes: The particle ID listed in Particles.

fields.name: Large Explosion Particle Data
fields.notes: Particle data as specified in Particles.

fields.name: Explosion Sound
fields.notes: ID in the minecraft:sound_event registry, or an inline definition.

fields.name: Chunk Z
fields.notes: Block coordinate divided by 16, rounded down.

fields.name: Chunk X
fields.notes: Block coordinate divided by 16, rounded down.

fields.name: Event
fields.notes: See below.

fields.name: Value
fields.notes: Depends on Event.

fields.name: Entity ID
fields.notes: The ID of the entity taking damage

fields.name: Yaw
fields.notes: The direction the damage is coming from in relation to the entity

fields.name: Old Diameter
fields.notes: Current length of a single side of the world border, in meters.

fields.name: New Diameter
fields.notes: Target length of a single side of the world border, in meters.

fields.name: Speed
fields.notes: Number of real-time milliseconds until New Diameter is reached. It appears that Notchian server does not sync world border speed to game ticks, so it gets out of sync with server lag. If the world border is not moving, this is set to 0.

fields.name: Portal Teleport Boundary
fields.notes: Resulting coordinates from a portal teleport are limited to ±value. Usually 29999984.

fields.name: Warning Blocks
fields.notes: In meters.

fields.name: Warning Time
fields.notes: In seconds as set by /worldborder warning time.

fields.name: Chunk X
fields.notes: Chunk coordinate (block coordinate divided by 16, rounded down)

fields.name: Chunk Z
fields.notes: Chunk coordinate (block coordinate divided by 16, rounded down)

fields.name: Heightmaps
fields.notes: See Chunk Format#Heightmaps structure

fields.name: Size
fields.notes: Size of Data in bytes

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: See Chunk Format#Data structure

fields.name: Number of block entities
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: The packed section coordinates are relative to the chunk they are in. Values 0-15 are valid. packed_xz = ((blockX & 15) > 4, z = packed_xz & 15 // decode

fields.name: Sky Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has data in the Sky Light array below. The least significant bit is for blocks 16 blocks to 1 block below the min world height (one section below the world), while the most significant bit covers blocks 1 to 16 blocks above the max world height (one section above the world).

fields.name: Block Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has data in the Block Light array below. The order of bits is the same as in Sky Light Mask.

fields.name: Empty Sky Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has all zeros for its Sky Light data. The order of bits is the same as in Sky Light Mask.

fields.name: Empty Block Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has all zeros for its Block Light data. The order of bits is the same as in Sky Light Mask.

fields.name: Sky Light array count
fields.notes: Number of entries in the following array; should match the number of bits set in Sky Light Mask

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: Length of the following array in bytes (always 2048)

fields.name: Block Light array count
fields.notes: Number of entries in the following array; should match the number of bits set in Block Light Mask

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: Length of the following array in bytes (always 2048)

fields.name: Event
fields.notes: The event, see below.

fields.name: Location
fields.notes: The location of the event.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Extra data for certain events, see below.

fields.name: Disable Relative Volume
fields.notes: See above.

fields.name: Long Distance
fields.notes: If true, particle distance increases from 256 to 65536.

fields.name: X
fields.notes: X position of the particle.

fields.name: Y
fields.notes: Y position of the particle.

fields.name: Z
fields.notes: Z position of the particle.

fields.name: Offset X
fields.notes: This is added to the X position after being multiplied by random.nextGaussian().

fields.name: Offset Y
fields.notes: This is added to the Y position after being multiplied by random.nextGaussian().

fields.name: Offset Z
fields.notes: This is added to the Z position after being multiplied by random.nextGaussian().

fields.name: Particle Count
fields.notes: The number of particles to create.

fields.name: Particle ID
fields.notes: The particle ID listed in Particles.

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Particle data as specified in Particles.

fields.name: Chunk X
fields.notes: Chunk coordinate (block coordinate divided by 16, rounded down)

fields.name: Chunk Z
fields.notes: Chunk coordinate (block coordinate divided by 16, rounded down)

fields.name: Sky Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has data in the Sky Light array below. The least significant bit is for blocks 16 blocks to 1 block below the min world height (one section below the world), while the most significant bit covers blocks 1 to 16 blocks above the max world height (one section above the world).

fields.name: Block Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has data in the Block Light array below. The order of bits is the same as in Sky Light Mask.

fields.name: Empty Sky Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has all zeros for its Sky Light data. The order of bits is the same as in Sky Light Mask.

fields.name: Empty Block Light Mask
fields.notes: BitSet containing bits for each section in the world + 2. Each set bit indicates that the corresponding 16×16×16 chunk section has all zeros for its Block Light data. The order of bits is the same as in Sky Light Mask.

fields.name: Sky Light array count
fields.notes: Number of entries in the following array; should match the number of bits set in Sky Light Mask

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: Length of the following array in bytes (always 2048)

fields.name: Block Light array count
fields.notes: Number of entries in the following array; should match the number of bits set in Block Light Mask

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: Length of the following array in bytes (always 2048)

fields.name: Entity ID
fields.notes: The player's Entity ID (EID).

fields.name: Dimension Count
fields.notes: Size of the following array.

fields.name: Dimension Names
fields.notes: Identifiers for all dimensions on the server.

fields.name: Max Players
fields.notes: Was once used by the client to draw the player list, but now is ignored.

fields.name: View Distance
fields.notes: Render distance (2-32).

fields.name: Simulation Distance
fields.notes: The distance that the client will process specific things, such as entities.

fields.name: Reduced Debug Info
fields.notes: If true, a Notchian client shows reduced information on the debug screen. For servers in development, this should almost always be false.

fields.name: Enable respawn screen
fields.notes: Set to false when the doImmediateRespawn gamerule is true.

fields.name: Do limited crafting
fields.notes: Whether players can only craft recipes they have already unlocked. Currently unused by the client.

fields.name: Dimension Type
fields.notes: The ID of the type of dimension in the minecraft:dimension_type registry, defined by the Registry Data packet.

fields.name: Dimension Name
fields.notes: Name of the dimension being spawned into.

fields.name: Hashed seed
fields.notes: First 8 bytes of the SHA-256 hash of the world's seed. Used client side for biome noise

fields.name: Game mode
fields.notes: 0: Survival, 1: Creative, 2: Adventure, 3: Spectator.

fields.name: Previous Game mode
fields.notes: -1: Undefined (null), 0: Survival, 1: Creative, 2: Adventure, 3: Spectator. The previous game mode. Vanilla client uses this for the debug (F3 + N & F3 + F4) game mode switch. (More information needed)

fields.name: Is Debug
fields.notes: True if the world is a debug mode world; debug mode worlds cannot be modified and have predefined blocks.

fields.name: Is Flat
fields.notes: True if the world is a superflat world; flat worlds have different void fog and a horizon at y=0 instead of y=63.

fields.name: Has death location
fields.notes: If true, then the next two fields are present.

fields.name: Death dimension name
fields.notes: Name of the dimension the player died in.

fields.name: Death location
fields.notes: The location that the player died at.

fields.name: Portal cooldown
fields.notes: The number of ticks until the player can use the portal again.

fields.name: Map ID
fields.notes: Map ID of the map being modified

fields.name: Scale
fields.notes: From 0 for a fully zoomed-in map (1 block per pixel) to 4 for a fully zoomed-out map (16 blocks per pixel)

fields.name: Locked
fields.notes: True if the map has been locked in a cartography table

fields.name: Icon Count
fields.notes: Number of elements in the following array. Only present if previous Boolean is true.

fields.name: Optional Array
fields.notes: See below

fields.name: Columns
fields.notes: Number of columns updated

fields.name: Rows
fields.notes: Only if Columns is more than 0; number of rows updated

fields.name: X
fields.notes: Only if Columns is more than 0; x offset of the westernmost column

fields.name: Z
fields.notes: Only if Columns is more than 0; z offset of the northernmost row

fields.name: Length
fields.notes: Only if Columns is more than 0; length of the following array

fields.name: Data
fields.notes: Only if Columns is more than 0; see Map item format

fields.name: Window ID
fields.notes: The ID of the window that is open; this is an int rather than a byte.

fields.name: Size
fields.notes: The number of trades in the following array.

fields.name: Array
fields.notes: See below. The first item the player has to supply for this villager trade. The count of the item stack is the default "price" of this trade.

fields.name: Villager level
fields.notes: Appears on the trade GUI; meaning comes from the translation key merchant.level. + level. 1: Novice, 2: Apprentice, 3: Journeyman, 4: Expert, 5: Master.

fields.name: Experience
fields.notes: Total experience for this villager (always 0 for the wandering trader).

fields.name: Is regular villager
fields.notes: True if this is a regular villager; false for the wandering trader. When false, hides the villager level and some other GUI elements.

fields.name: Can restock
fields.notes: True for regular villagers and false for the wandering trader. If true, the "Villagers restock up to two times per day." message is displayed when hovering over disabled trades.

fields.name: Delta X
fields.notes: Change in X position as currentX * 4096 - prevX * 4096.

fields.name: Delta Y
fields.notes: Change in Y position as currentY * 4096 - prevY * 4096.

fields.name: Delta Z
fields.notes: Change in Z position as currentZ * 4096 - prevZ * 4096.

fields.name: Delta X

fields.name: Message Signature Present

fields.name: Message Signature bytes
fields.notes: Only present if Message Signature Present is true. Cryptography, the signature consists of the Sender UUID, Session UUID from the Player Session packet, Index, Salt, Timestamp in epoch seconds, the length of the original chat content, the original content itself, the length of Previous Messages, and all of the Previous message signatures. These values are hashed with SHA-256 and signed using the RSA cryptosystem. Modifying any of these values in the packet will cause this signature to fail. This buffer is always 256 bytes long and it is not length-prefixed.

fields.name: Message
fields.notes: Raw (optionally) signed sent message content. This is used as the content parameter when formatting the message on the client.

fields.name: Timestamp
fields.notes: Represents the time the message was signed as milliseconds since the epoch, used to check if the message was received within 2 minutes of it being sent.

fields.name: Salt

fields.name: VarInt

fields.name: Message ID
fields.notes: The message Id + 1, used for validating message signature. The next field is present only when value of this field is equal to 0.

fields.name: Signature

fields.name: Unsigned Content Present

fields.name: Filter Type

fields.name: Filter Type Bits
